description: One IPv4 address mapped to one or more hostnames for the container's /etc/hosts

ip.description: IPv4 address the hostnames resolve to (e.g. "10.0.0.5")

hostnames.description: One or more hostnames that resolve to this address inside the container

ports.description: Optional TCP/UDP destination ports this host is reachable on (e.g. [443]). Scopes the firewall reachability for this host only, so you can open a single LAN service on one port: in restricted mode while the rest of egress stays open, in allowlist mode while everything else stays closed (there a private host requires a port scope, without the DNS ports 53 and 853). Empty inherits the global allowed_ports (else all ports). Applied in restricted and allowlist mode; ignored in open mode.
